international.title: Crimea bridge shut after reported Ukrainian strike, as Russia hits Kyiv crossings
international.summary: The bridge linking Crimea and Russia has reportedly sustained major damage, while two routes through Kyiv are closed.

international.title: Ukraine critically damages Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia
international.summary: Photos of bridge, built after 2014 annexation and viewed by Ukraine as illegal, suggest massive steel arch has fallen into water Ukraine has critically damaged the Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia in an overnight missile attack, in what Ukrainian officials say is a symbolic blow to the Kremlin. Footage showed a Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missile seconds before it hit the road and railway crossing, followed by an explosion. The strike follows an earlier attack on Monday that targeted an arch across its central section. Continue reading...
